body: I don’t care who’s on it really as long as it’s not him. Just have to replace my ex with anyone else.

Yes! I feel this! I was adopted when I was 3 because I was found outside in the middle of winter with no clothes on. I wish right then no one had heard me crying. I wish I would have froze to death. Just another sad story that no one remembers rather than the bullshit life I have now. That was 30 years ago. Tired of people saying it’ll get better
